Example Bank Everyday Visa® Card. Rewards on the purchases you make every day, with no foreign transaction fees.

Example Bank Everyday Visa®

Earn 4X points at U.S. supermarkets on up to $25,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X.

Earn 3X points at restaurants worldwide.

Earn 1X points on all other purchases.

Points are Everyday Points. Each point is worth 1 cent when you redeem it for a statement credit, and points don't expire as long as your account is open.

Supermarket purchases don't include superstores, warehouse clubs, gas stations or specialty food stores. Merchants are assigned a category by the card network based on the merchant category code they choose.

Welcome offer: earn 60,000 bonus points after you spend $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. This is a limited-time offer for new cardmembers.

Rates and fees

FeeAmount
Annual fee: $95Charged on your first statement and every year after.
No foreign transaction feesPurchases made outside the United States cost nothing extra.
Late paymentUp to $40.

Purchase APR: a variable rate based on the Prime Rate and your creditworthiness. See the pricing and terms for details about the rates, fees and other costs of this card.

Card benefits

Extended warranty and auto rental coverage come with the Everyday Visa. See the Guide to Benefits for the terms, conditions and exclusions that apply to each benefit.
